name: 04274 · Poland, ME
findings: ZIP 04274 (Poland) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (80% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04274 (Poland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
